ports.label: USB
ports.note: 2 on front panel (USB type assumed A); front also has OLED display and standby button

slots.label: Input connector card slots
slots.note: Field-swappable; 2/4/6 cards for 8/16/24 4K60p inputs. Card types: 4x HDMI 2.0, 4x DisplayPort 1.2, 4x 12G-SDI, 4x SFP+ (AVoIP: NDI, SDVoE, ST 2110). Max 24x 4K60p or 48x 2K/DL inputs.

slots.label: Output connector card slots
slots.note: Field-swappable; up to 20 active 4K60p outputs (7 card models incl. 4x HDMI 2.0, 4x DP 1.2, 12G-SDI, SFP+ per datasheet/product page). Exact per-card list not fully confirmed.
